verdict.rationale: Gazebo documents headless server-only mode (-s flag) and lightweight server-only packages, plus extensive CLI tools and TCP/IP transport for remote servers — all of which are technical enablers for running simulations in CI pipelines. However, there is no direct evidence of CI integration guides, automated test frameworks, or documented regression-testing workflows/examples for robot software validation. missing for 10: CI pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions/Jenkins configs), a documented test framework or assertions API for simulation-based regression tests, and case studies of automated CI testing.
